build: Add anti-drift doctrine intake candidates to doctrine catalog
objective: Record the five user-provided anti-drift doctrines in the repository without falsely promoting them to v10 doctrine.
verification: Catalog lists existing promoted doctrine files from doctrines/.
Catalog lists the five new intake doctrine candidates and marks them as not v10/promoted.
Each new intake file has frontmatter with source, received date, status:intake, and promoted_to:null.
